# Mini App Factory

> A powerful AI-powered web application that generates production-ready static websites from natural language descriptions.

## Overview
Mini App Factory is an AI-driven platform that transforms natural language prompts into complete, production-ready static websites. Users describe what they want, and the AI generates, previews, and deploys fully functional web applications.

## Key Features
- **AI Website Generation** — Generate complete websites from natural language descriptions
- **Visual Reference Upload** — Upload reference images for design guidance
- **Live Preview** — Real-time preview of generated sites
- **Code Editor** — Built-in code editor with file tree for custom edits
- **Template System** — Pre-built templates to accelerate development
- **Project Management** — Organize and manage multiple projects
- **One-click Deploy** — Deploy generated sites instantly
- **Multi-model Support** — Choose from various AI models for generation
- **Admin Console** — AI-powered admin dashboard for platform management

## Pages
- `/` — Landing page
- `/dashboard` — Project dashboard
- `/edit/[projectName]` — Code editor workspace
- `/admin` — Admin dashboard
- `/admin/models` — AI model management
- `/docs` — Documentation
- `/settings` — User settings
- `/support` — Support page
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy
- `/eula` — End User License Agreement

## Tech Stack
- Next.js (App Router)
- Convex (Backend/Database)
- Stack Auth (Authentication)
- AI/LLM Integration
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
